svg.title: Pack four overlapping motifs into 37 bases
svg.desc: Choose four 16-base motifs and a 37-base limit; calculate directional overlap costs; select a path costing 0, 7, 7, 7, and 16 bases; read the complete packed duplex. Adapted by Eric J. South from the supplied process figure for Andreani, South, and Dunlop (2024).
